body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Force Damage; ignore 1 point of cover bonus if you can detect the target's occupied space.

surges.html: Learn whether the target's cover is solid or only visual.

rider.title: Strain - Assault
rider.html: If you accepted Strain and hit, the target cannot provide cover for another creature against your next Psionics Action until the start of your next turn.
